name: eos-electron
description: Eos desktop app (Electron). Serves app/ui/dist over a re-registered eos:// scheme and connects to the already-running local daemon. Builds/runs only inside this dir — never touches /Applications/Eos.app.
author: Eos

scripts.start: npm run bundle && node scripts/ensure-dev.mjs && electron-forge start
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['.forge-build', 'out']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
